name: ShowMojo
positioning: Market-leading leasing automation, now with AI — fill vacancies at scale without adding headcount.
description: ShowMojo is an automated leasing platform for property managers. It publishes listings to more than 50 rental sites, responds to and follows up with leads automatically, coordinates in-person and self-guided showings, runs credit, background and ID checks on prospects, and reports on leasing-funnel performance to owners.
real_estate_use: A property manager with vacant units lets ShowMojo publish and keep listings updated across rental sites, then hands off lead response and showing scheduling to the platform instead of coordinating each tour by phone or email. A prospect touring a self-guided unit unlocks it with ShowMojo's access control after being verified, and once they apply, the same platform runs the tenant screening before the manager reviews the file and signs a lease.
features: Automated listing syndication to 50+ rental sites
Smart-lock access control for self-guided tours
Owner reporting on the leasing funnel

use_cases.job: Automate showing scheduling and lead follow-up for a portfolio of vacant units
Track leasing-funnel performance across a portfolio from real-time owner reports

pricing.unit: per unit / year, annual Pro plan
